display_title: Love is a Sport: Victory, Gold Hunters!
description:
Sun-Woo is an Olympic gold medalist and Korea’s pride in air shooting. He has everything under control until fencing rookie Seong-Han asks for a handshake to “borrow his winning energy.” After that, Seong-Han takes gold, and Sun-Woo crashes spectacularly. Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. What begins as a heated rivalry between two athletes quickly turns into something far more dangerous. In the Olympic Village, competition is not the only thing raising the tension.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*
